evals.prompt: 安全审查登录/注册/评论/上传这些功能，防止外部恶意攻击。
evals.expected_output: Scopes and threat-models the four surfaces, verifies current code with grep/read, produces a severity-ranked report with trigger/fix/verification.
assertions: Reports only real findings with evidence

evals.prompt: 正则消毒器被 javascript 编码绕过，图片丢了/脚本能注入。
evals.expected_output: Applies parser-level whitelist (HtmlSanitizer/Ganss.Xss), adds regression tests per bypass class, configures allowed tags/attrs/schemes.
assertions: Adds regression tests per bypass class

evals.prompt: 上传图片要防 polyglot 文件执行，含 SVG 拒收。
evals.expected_output: Applies layered upload validation: extension allowlist (no svg), magic bytes, real decode, dimension cap, re-encode, sanitized filename, nosniff.
assertions: Validates by extension then magic bytes then decode
Re-encodes to strip trailing non-image bytes

evals.prompt: JWT 要加吊销机制和生产环境防开发密钥。
evals.expected_output: Adds jti revocation, ValidAlgorithms whitelist, short expiry, and fail-fast on dev keys with fixture-safe test setup.
assertions: Adds jti claim and revocation path
Throws at startup on dev key outside Development

evals.prompt: 登录接口没有限流，暴力破解风险。
evals.expected_output: Uses net8 built-in RateLimiter with per-IP partitions, lazy IOptions reads, 429 + Retry-After, XFF spoofing awareness.

evals.prompt: 做一次常规代码质量分析。
evals.expected_output: Routes general quality analysis to ada-code-quality-analysis.
Routes feature PR review to ada-requesting-code-review / ada-pr-review.

evals.prompt: 审计有状态服务的状态一致性。
